title: Publish a reusable VIXEN CodeGraph index for engine lanes
body: Mandatory discovery failed: bash tools/codegraph-vixen.sh "lookdev shadow lighting" exited 2 because neither the lane nor canonical VIXEN checkout has .codegraph. codegraph explore --path . "lookdev shadow lighting" --max-files 5 also reported no index. Recovery used the documented rg fallback without creating an index. Publish a shared indexed checkout and automatically resolve VIXEN_CODEGRAPH_ROOT so engine audits have source and call-path discovery.

title: Derive live recipe invalidation for every shader registry consumer
body: Lightunify had to collect shader-library handles during host registration and explicitly mark them dirty in RecompileProceduralShader; previously only the primary march rebuilt, leaving shadow/probe fields stale. Make shared recipe-registry source dependencies declarative and derive consumer invalidation and occupancy wiring from them.

title: Apply the canonical GPU environment to every application capture test
body: Fresh baseline command: UT_STALL_IDLE_HARD_S=1800 bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent lightunify --resource gpu --label lightunify:baseline-regression-captures -- env -u DISPLAY -u VK_ICD_FILENAMES -u VK_DRIVER_FILES ctest --test-dir build/wsl -R "^(vixen_editor_capture_producer|vixen_hud_capture_producer|vixen_wsl_capture_witness|HeadlessStarfieldGraph\..*)$" --output-on-failure. HeadlessStarfieldGraph.CaptureFirst and CaptureSecond fail before rendering with VK_ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER; their registration omits VIXEN_CTEST_GPU_ENVIRONMENT used by the working lookdev fixtures. Recovery supplies the canonical LD_LIBRARY_PATH to the queued starfield command; this lane also wires the existing environment into those CTest registrations. Consolidate registration through the existing GPU test helper so capture targets cannot omit loader/ICD setup.

title: Provide GPU timing isolation without reserving every CPU queue token
body: The baseline command tools/run-lightunify-captures.sh build/wsl .tmp/lightunify/before originally requested --resource gpu --exclusive for each state. Midday completed, but lightunify:before:late-afternoon remained unstarted while needing all 15 CPU pair-tokens despite spare CPU and GPU capacity; same-agent starfield recovery then yielded to that request. Cancelled only its waiting wrapper PID 16209, retained the completed immutable midday capture, removed --exclusive and resumed explicitly at late-afternoon through the real GPU queue. The existing GPU mutex serializes the payload without all CPU tokens. Suggested consolidation: an explicit GPU timing witness reservation that isolates the GPU while allowing unrelated CPU compiles, and an output-provenance-aware state resume mechanism.

title: Declare pass-output snapshots before pipelined buffer reuse
body: The first shadow-mask witness mapped HitRecord after Render returned and attributed hits using authored order although BodyOctreeSceneNode sorts instances. Existing pipelined consumers document a later-primary-rewrite hazard; the default fixture samples still retained wave bits. Recovery exports runtime ordering and uses an optional post-dispatch command recorder to copy the real wave output before any possible reuse. Consolidate readback snapshot lifetime and ownership in the declarative graph so clients need no manual VkBuffer allocation or callback.

title: Resolve the worktree FetchContent cache from the VIXEN preset
body: Fresh configure/build required the extra environment VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=$PWD/.tmp/fetch on every queued CMake invocation to preserve authorized worktree-local dependency provisioning. The facade/preset should derive its own consumer-local fetch cache and keep this environmental setup out of lane commands. Exact route: env VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=$PWD/.tmp/fetch bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent lightunify --resource build --label lightunify:baseline-configure-resume -- nice -n10 cmake --preset vixen-wsl -S VIXEN.

title: Make dotnet run honor its worktree-local CodegenTool artifacts path
body: The queued dotnet run with --artifacts-path .tmp/lightunify/codegen-artifacts restored and built the pinned tool, then exited 1 because it launched from the pinned source snapshot's default bin/Release/net8.0/CodegenTool path instead of the artifact output. Running dotnet .tmp/lightunify/codegen-artifacts/bin/CodegenTool/release/CodegenTool.dll with the same LightingConfig --check passed. Provide a supported consumer-local run path so verification does not require manually bypassing dotnet run's launcher.

title: Generate the analytic visibility bit layout from the light contract
body: To expand the four-light HitRecord mask to the declared 16-light capacity while preserving the reservoir and policy fields, this lane manually reserves bits 0..3 and 16..27 and encodes the offset in analyticLightVisibilityBit plus a literal mask. The facade has no shared generated ownership/layout for this packed word, so each shader consumer can drift. Generate the light-index-to-bit mapping and mask from the declared capacity and reserved fields.

title: Provide the prescribed content-codegen light gate in consumer trees
body: Worker verification invokes bash tools/check-content-codegen.sh, but this VIXEN worktree has no such file in either tools/ or VIXEN/tools/. The lane had to rely on the fresh CMake build's 22 *_check targets plus a direct pinned CodegenTool --check. Publish the documented light-gate wrapper in consumer trees or point the brief at the existing per-consumer generation target.

title: Centralize shared SVO shader include roots for direct shader test builders
body: The SpatialReuseShade direct test builder registered only VIXEN/shaders while production shader builders also append libraries/SVO/shaders, so adding the shared recipe core include made five shadow tests fail before execution. Provide a reusable include-root helper or builder contract so direct shader tests and graph-built stages resolve the same registry kernels.

title: Derive direct Vulkan test descriptor layouts from shader reflection
body: The shadow-correctness GPU test manually mirrors shader descriptor layouts and pool counts. Integrating the shared visibility pass required updating its binding-48 buffer pool and binding-35 image type by hand; stale declarations produced descriptor allocation and pipeline type failures before exercising shadows. Generate test descriptor layouts and pool counts from the same reflected interface used by production builders.

title: Offer a single-pass queued look-dev capture artifact mode
body: The only registered look-dev CTest command runs each selected lighting state's full four-angle render twice in fresh processes for pixel equality. Producing requested before/after sheets and timestamp distributions consequently takes about ten minutes per state even when a separate pixel-repeat witness is not required. Add a supported single-pass per-state artifact mode that inherits the same CTest Vulkan environment and preserves the repeat-pixel gate as a separate check.
